symbols.name: call parameter
symbols.meaning: The parameter of a recursive call: the number of digits per interchanged chunk, or the number of selected axes in a butterfly layer.
symbols.quote: A call has a parameter $f$, the number of digits per interchanged chunk or of selected axes, and a volume $V$.

symbols.name: slot count
symbols.meaning: The number of size-f slots into which a call at parameter mf cuts its parameter, equal to 10^6, the label-space dimension.
symbols.quote: A call at parameter $mf$, with $m=10^6$ (the label-space dimension) slots of size $f$, deals its rows into $W$ streams of volume $V/W$, one per wire of a fixed bit or complex [exchange network](exchange-network.md).

symbols.name: number of smaller calls
symbols.meaning: The number of calls at parameter f made by a call at parameter mf: the total rank of the frame changes over all edges of the network.
symbols.quote: So the call makes $s$ calls at parameter $f$, each on volume $V/W$, where $s$ is the total edge rank.

symbols.name: cost per unit volume
symbols.meaning: F(f) is the running time of a call at parameter f divided by the volume of its data.
symbols.quote: With $F(f)$ the time per unit volume at parameter $f$, these cost $s(V/W)F(f)$.

symbols.name: recursion depth
symbols.meaning: The number of recursion levels between the top call and the nodes considered.
symbols.quote: Unrolling through $\log_m f$ levels ($f$ a power of $m$), with depth $j$ (here counting levels) contributing $(s/W)^j$, gives $F(f)=O\big(\sum_{j=0}^{\log_m f}(s/W)^j\big)$.

symbols.name: saving exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent below 1 with s/W < m^tau, which makes an interchange cost O(V f^tau); here tau = 1 - 2^{-50}.
symbols.quote: If $s/W<m^\tau$ with fixed $\tau<1$, this is $O(f^\tau)$: if $s/W\le1$ there are $1+\log_m f$ terms of at most $1$; otherwise the last term, below $m^{\tau\log_m f}=f^\tau$, dominates the geometric sum.

symbols.name: relative rank deficit
symbols.meaning: The fraction (Wm - s)/(Wm) by which the number of smaller calls s falls short of Wm.
symbols.quote: Write $s/W=m(1-\eta)$, with $\eta$ now the relative deficit $(Wm-s)/(Wm)$.

relations.quote: The recursion gets its strict inequality $s<Wm$ from [Nested subspace labels and rank deficit](subspace-labels.md): an edge costs the dimension change of its nested labels, so a wire climbing from $0$ to $m$ dimensions costs $m$.

derivations.quote: Crossing a network edge changes the stream's frame ([Frames on wire arrays](array-frames.md)), costing one call at parameter $f$ on that stream per unit of rank of the change. So the call makes $s$ calls at parameter $f$, each on volume $V/W$, where $s$ is the total edge rank.

Since $m<2^{20}$, $\ln m<20\ln 2<20$; as the exponential lies above its tangent at $0$, $m^{1-2^{-50}}=m\exp(-2^{-50}\ln m)>m(1-2^{-50}\ln m)>m(1-20\cdot2^{-50})>m(1-\eta)=s/W$ for either network. Hence $\tau=\sigma=1-2^{-50}$ gives $s/W<m^\tau$ (bit) and $s/W<m^\sigma$ (complex), exponents barely below $1$.
